items.title: Announcing the Swift Student Challenge 2027
items.summary: Apple is proud to support the next generation of developers, creators, and entrepreneurs with the Swift Student Challenge. The Challenge gives students from around the world the opportunity to showcase their creativity and app development skills.The Challenge is open February 8–28, 2027. And new this year, students can submit an app for any Apple platform. Learn more
